title: Sources: Walmart-backed Indian fintech PhonePe resumes its IPO preparations, targeting a Q1 2027 debut at a $12B to $15B valuation and raising $1.2B to $1.5B (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Sources: Walmart-backed Indian fintech PhonePe resumes its IPO preparations, targeting a Q1 2027 debut at a $12B to $15B valuation and raising $1.2B to $1.5B — Indian fintech PhonePe has resumed preparations for its initial public offering and is targeting a listing in the first three months …
